# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book gathers, in reading order, the results of a research programme built on a simple idea: describing the
qubit by what is measured. The qang unit (qg) expresses a qubit's state on the scale on which the experiment delivers
it, the polar bias $qg_Z=\langle\sigma_z\rangle$, and that choice yields a practical tool, the **qg symmetry filter**:
when a circuit conserves a number (excitations, photons, neutrino flavour, mass), the shots that violate it can only
come from noise and are discarded.

The book goes from the foundations (Parts I and II) to the applications: neutrinos (Part III), teleportation in
optical networks (Part IV), information-theoretic models of time loops and black holes (Part V), cryptography
(Part VI), quantum machine learning (Part VII), dynamics and chemistry (Part VIII), error correction and
characterization (Part IX). Part X gathers the evidence: the method, the confirmed advantages, the limits and the
negative results, and the first run on real hardware.

## How to read the results

Three conventions run through the book:

- **Predictions recorded before running.** Every experiment cited fixed its predictions before it was run (a commit
  or a sha256 hash of the script), and is reported as passed or failed. Failures are not left out: many of the
  book's lessons come from them.
- **Simulated noise unless stated.** Whatever is described "on a device" refers to calibrated noise models of IBM or
  IonQ processors, except for the real-hardware results, which are marked explicitly (Chapter 31).
- **References to the notes.** Citations such as (§151) point to the corresponding section of the project's research
  notes (`RESEARCH_NOTES.md`), where the code, the tests and the data are.

## Code and data

All the material is open: the `qang` library (`pip install qang`), the script of every experiment, the runnable
notebooks and the data are at [github.com/Viny2030/qang](https://github.com/Viny2030/qang). The software record has
the DOI [10.5281/zenodo.22832150](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22832150).

## Status of this edition

The book is written and published chapter by chapter. Chapters marked "in preparation" show their planned contents
and are completed in successive editions.
